## What differs and must be verified
GNAO1-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with involuntary movements) looks similar clinically but shares no supported mechanism, so it is excluded. [f94ad5494a3e9ab8]

GRIN1-related disease (neurodevelopmental disorder with or without hyperkinetic movements and seizures, autosomal dominant) overlaps only weakly at Neurexins and neuroligins, a related process but a different step. [9b5a310872598764, 072a91fd2fdb335f, ce6dd3aad07a277e]
